ValidationRule.description: Validates that the feature version being received is not lower than what is currently available
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, NOT(ISNULL(PRIORVALUE( OCV_Feature_Version__c))), OR( ISNULL(OCV_Feature_Version__c), OCV_Feature_Version__c < PRIORVALUE(OCV_Feature_Version__c) ) )
